title: Senior Expense Analyst
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE
As our Senior Expense Analyst, you will champion Everpure’s global Travel & Expense (T&E) ecosystem, optimizing enterprise Concur systems to ensure seamless financial operations, compliance, and user experiences. Partnering closely with finance, IT, and cross-functional teams, you will drive process automation, strengthen internal SOX controls, and eliminate operational risk. Your analytical insights will directly inform executive decision-making and scale global travel governance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Architect & Optimize Enterprise T&E Systems: Lead end-to-end administration, system configurations, and intelligence reporting within Concur to drive continuous process simplification, workflow automation, and seamless integration across corporate platforms.

• Strengthen Global Governance & SOX Controls: Establish, monitor, and audit T&E control frameworks aligned with internal SOX practices to prevent fraud, eliminate duplicate reimbursements, and maintain audit readiness across all business units.

• Deliver Executive Data & Analytics: Design actionable T&E metrics, dashboards, and reporting models for business leaders to enhance spend visibility, optimize travel budgets, and guide strategic financial planning.

• Drive Process Excellence & Stakeholder Enablement: Facilitate live interactive webinars and training sessions, establish industry best practices, and resolve complex T&E queries to deliver exceptional internal customer support.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 8+ Years of Specialized Concur & T&E Experience: Extensive hands-on background administering and configuring Concur Travel & Expense, managing Intelligence Reporting, and driving enterprise workflow optimizations.

• Financial Governance & Audit Expertise: Deep knowledge of expense management best practices, internal auditing, and SOX compliance frameworks designed to mitigate financial risk and standardize global policies.

• Data Analytics & Technical Problem-Solving: Proven ability to analyze complex financial data, map process flows, and translate operational needs into clear technical requirements and system enhancements.

• Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication: Strong project management and interpersonal skills, with a track record of building trusted partnerships, leading global training programs, and applying sound judgment to policy decisions.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• Innovation : We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

• Growth : We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

• Team : We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out purebenefits.com for more information.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence – Fashion & Luxury AI Venture | BIANCO VENTURES
description:
Bianco Ventures è un company builder verticale dedicato alla creazione di startup software B2B per il mondo Fashion & Luxury. Uniamo capitale, execution e conoscenza profonda del mercato fin dal primo giorno, insieme a partner come Deloitte, GELLIFY e ARAD, per costruire nuove imprese con chi conosce il settore dall'interno.
Non siamo un fondo. Non siamo un acceleratore. Costruiamo imprese vere, partendo da problemi veri.
La venture oggetto di questa ricerca è la prima iniziativa live del nostro ecosistema. Stiamo cercando la persona che la guidi.
La sfida
Nelle organizzazioni retail distribuite, decine, centinaia di punti vendita, mercati diversi, team locali con autonomia operativa, il coordinamento tra struttura centrale e rete è uno dei problemi più persistenti e ancora poco risolti dalla tecnologia.
Le linee guida partono dall'HQ. Cosa succede dopo è spesso invisibile. L'execution reale, la qualità con cui le direttive diventano azione nei singoli store, viene misurata tardi, se viene misurata. I dati ci sono, ma sono frammentati, manuali, non strutturati.
Questo è il problema che stiamo affrontando.
La venture
Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma B2B software e AI focalizzata sulla retail execution e sull'operational intelligence per il Fashion, il Luxury e il Retail mid-market.
La venture nasce da un'analisi concreta del mercato e da interlocuzioni dirette con i decision maker del settore. La tesi di mercato è sviluppata. La value proposition iniziale è strutturata. Il problema è reale e ancora largamente irrisolto dagli strumenti oggi disponibili.
Siamo in fase early-stage. Il prodotto e il modello di business devono ancora essere validati e costruiti, questa è esattamente la ragione per cui stiamo cercando chi voglia farlo.
Il ruolo
Cerchiamo un'Entrepreneur in Residence che agisca come founder operativa/o della venture.
Non si tratta di un incarico consulenziale. Non è un ruolo di product management interno. Non è innovation management.
È ownership reale di un'impresa in costruzione: dalla customer discovery alla prima revenue, dalla definizione del prodotto alla creazione del team, dal go-to-market alla preparazione allo spin-off.
Avrai autonomia concreta. Avrai il supporto di un ecosistema attivo. Avrai accesso a stakeholder industriali che raramente si trovano nella stessa stanza.
Cosa farai nei primi 6-9 mesi
Nei primi mesi costruirai le fondamenta operative e commerciali della venture. In concreto:

• Approfondirai la customer discovery, intervistando Retail Director, Head of VM, COO e altri decision maker del settore, per validare il problema e misurare la willingness to pay

• Raffinerai la value proposition in dialogo con il mercato reale, non con ipotesi interne

• Coordinerai la costruzione dell'MVP con il team tecnologico, definendo le priorità di prodotto in funzione di ciò che hai imparato sul campo

• Progetterai e gestirai i primi pilot con brand selezionati, raccogliendo evidenze qualitative e quantitative

• Definirai il modello commerciale (pricing, segmentazione, struttura contrattuale) partendo dai dati, non da benchmark generici

• Costruirai il go-to-market iniziale e acquisirai i primi clienti paganti

• Coordinerai partner tecnologici, fornitori e risorse dedicate

• Definirai KPI e milestone della venture e le presenterai agli stakeholder e ai potenziali investitori

• Costruirai il primo team intorno alla venture

• Preparerai la società allo spin-off e al fundraising seed
Chi cerchiamo
Consideriamo profili con 5-10 anni di esperienza che abbiano lavorato in almeno uno di questi ambiti: startup early-stage, venture building, product management B2B, growth, SaaS enterprise, retail tech, AI o innovation.
Quello che non è negoziabile:

• Capacità di condurre customer discovery in contesti enterprise, sapere ascoltare, sapere sintetizzare, sapere cambiare idea quando i dati lo richiedono

• Attitudine commerciale: saper portare una soluzione davanti a un buyer, gestire il ciclo di vendita, chiudere

title: Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Pay
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.

• Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.

• Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep

• Strong analytical capabilities to interpret simulation and lab data to identify issues and provide solutions to fix identified problems.

• Familiarity with printed circuit board design, fabrication, and assembly.

• Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to facilitate global communication both internally and with external customers.

• Individuals must be highly motivated, a quick learner, and able to work independently

Competencies

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

title: Senior Manager Accès au Marché & Affaires Publiques Dispositif Médical
description:
L’entreprise
Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ : DXCM) est un pionnier et un leader mondial dans le domaine de la surveillance continue du glucose (CGM). Dexcom a commencé comme une petite entreprise avec un grand rêve : transformer à jamais la gestion du diabète. Libérer des informations et des perspectives qui favorisent de meilleurs résultats de santé. Vingt-cinq ans plus tard, nous avons créé une industrie. Et ce n’est que le début. Nous élargissons notre vision au-delà du diabète pour permettre aux individus de prendre le contrôle de leur santé. Cela signifie des informations personnalisées et exploitables visant à résoudre des défis de santé majeurs. Pour continuer ce que nous avons commencé : améliorer la santé humaine.
Nous sommes portés par des milliers de personnes ambitieuses et passionnées à travers le monde, prêtes à s’engager pour gagner la confiance de nos clients en écoutant, en servant avec intégrité, en voyant grand et en étant fiables. Nous avons déjà changé des millions de vies et nous sommes prêts à en changer des millions d'autres. Notre ambition future est de devenir une entreprise de technologie de santé grand public de premier plan tout en continuant à développer des solutions pour des problèmes de santé graves. Nous y parviendrons en réinventant constamment des expériences uniques basées sur la biosurveillance. Bien que nous ayons parcouru un long chemin depuis nos débuts modestes, nos rêves sont plus grands que jamais. L’opportunité d’améliorer la santé à l’échelle mondiale est devant nous.

Votre future équipe
Chez Dexcom , nous transformons la prise en charge du diabète grâce à des technologies innovantes de surveillance continue du glucose (CGM) qui améliorent concrètement la vie des patients. En tant que Senior Manager Accès au Marché & Affaires Publiques, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au sein de la filiale française en contribuant directement à l'élargissement de l'accès des patients aux solutions Dexcom .
À l'interface entre les autorités de santé, les payeurs, les décideurs institutionnels et les équipes internes, vous définirez et mettrez en œuvre les stratégies permettant de démontrer la valeur clinique, économique et organisationnelle de nos technologies.
Votre rôle

• Vous définissez et mettez en œuvre la stratégie d'accès au marché de Dexcom en France pour l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits et services, en cohérence avec les objectifs de la filiale et de la région EMEA.

• Vous analysez les évolutions du système de santé, des politiques publiques, des mécanismes de remboursement et de l'environnement concurrentiel afin d'identifier les opportunités et les risques pour l'entreprise.

• Vous pilotez les stratégies d'accès et de remboursement lors du lancement de nouvelles indications, de nouveaux produits ou de nouvelles solutions digitales notamment à travers la préparation des dossiers destinés aux autorités de santé françaises en partenariat avec les équipes EMEA et les partenaires externes.

• Vous développez et défendez des argumentaires de valeur au cours des négociations de prix intégrant les dimensions cliniques, médico-économiques, budgétaires et organisationnelles afin de soutenir les décisions de remboursement et de financement.

• Vous élaborez et déployez une stratégie Affaires Publiques visant à renforcer la visibilité et la crédibilité de Dexcom auprès des décideurs institutionnels, des payeurs et des acteurs influents du système de santé.

• Vous représentez Dexcom au sein des associations professionnelles, groupes de travail et instances sectorielles pertinentes afin de promouvoir l'innovation et l'amélioration de la prise en charge du diabète.

• Vous identifiez les besoins en génération de données médico-économiques, d'études d'impact budgétaire et de Real-World Evidence afin de renforcer les démonstrations de valeur des technologies Dexcom .

• Vous êtes le référent Accès au Marché de la filiale française et contribuez activement à la montée en compétences des équipes

title: Head of Sourcing Enablement & Delivery
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Sourcing & Procurement helps OpenAI secure the products, services, and partnerships that support our research, build our products, and grow our business. We work with teams across the company to make sound commercial decisions and move important work forward.

As OpenAI grows, we are rethinking how sourcing works: bringing expertise into decisions earlier, simplifying contracting, and using AI to give Procurement more time for judgment and strategic work. What we learn internally-and through our supplier and enterprise-buyer relationships-can also inform better products, partnerships, and industry adoption.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a senior leader to head Sourcing Enablement & Delivery, leading sourcing operational delivery, contracting enablement, and AI transformation-and building Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI’s commercial growth. You will build the teams, systems, service model, and cross-functional partnerships that enable sourcing and contracting at scale, helping teams move quickly without losing commercial discipline or accountability.

You will partner with GTM, Sales, and Partnerships to develop Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI adoption and commercial growth. Bring procurement-industry knowledge, buyer insights, and lessons from internal AI use into customer engagement, product feedback, and opportunities across the procurement ecosystem.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Sourcing, you will manage the Sourcing Delivery and Contract Management leaders and shape this new function’s priorities, team, and measures of success.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

PRIORITIES AND WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- A focused roadmap: clear choices about what to build first, what to defer, and how progress will be measured.

- Stronger delivery: capable leaders and teams, faster execution, less rework, and fewer unresolved ownership gaps.

- AI adoption: sustained use of AI-enabled capabilities, with measurable gains in quality, capacity, and user experience.

- Commercial results: increased OpenAI adoption across the procurement industry and a measurable contribution to commercial growth, consistent with independent supplier selection and purchasing decisions.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build and lead the organization. Hire and develop managers, coach performance, and build succession and leadership depth. Decide how employees, contractors, delivery partners, and AI share the work. Hold leaders accountable for results, capacity, and team health.

- Own sourcing enablement and delivery operations. Set service commitments and quality standards with the Delivery and Contract Management leaders. Match support to deal complexity and risk, and use internal customer feedback to improve the service. Category and Sourcing leads retain ownership of their strategies and deals, including supplier selection, negotiations, and purchasing.

- Lead the sourcing operating rhythm. Bring demand, priorities, and capacity into one forward plan, informed by workload and performance data. Work with category leaders to make tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and follow through on commitments. Provide inputs to Procurement-wide planning and functional business reviews.

- Strengthen contracting. Partner with Legal and Procurement Operations/COE on contract lifecycle management, approved templates, and negotiation playbooks that improve quality and free category teams to focus on strategic deals.

- Lead RACI development. Define responsibilities, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths within Procurement and across partner teams. Define how the team prioritizes work, allocates resources, and resolves delivery issues.

- Create mechanisms to bring sourcing into decisions earlier: connect business demand, supplier activity, and renewals-including work outside formal intake-with Sourcing teams

title: Facility Operator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands

.

ROLE SCOPE

- Serve as the on-site SME for data center critical infrastructure, handling escalations across the white space and the supporting facilities.

- Act as first responder on-site for incidents, driving resolution with support from engineering and infrastructure SMEs.

- Partner with colo partners, vendors, and internal teams to keep the site reliable, and feed operational learnings back into design and process.

title: Copywriter

Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.
Are You Ready?
This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.
Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?
As a Copywriter at Decentralized Masters , you'll be at the forefront of a financial revolution, shaping the future of decentralized finance (DeFi) through the power of words. From crafting compelling website copy to developing engaging social media content, your words will inspire, educate, and empower individuals worldwide to seize control of their financial destiny.

• Growth: Be part of a record-breaking company experiencing exponential growth and poised for unicorn status in the coming years.

• Culture: Join a diverse and dynamic team of industry experts and innovators who are passionate about empowering others and driving positive change.

• A proven track record as a skilled copywriter with a portfolio that speaks volumes.

• A passion for finance, blockchain technology, and the democratization of financial services.

• Exceptional writing skills with the ability to distil complex concepts into clear, engaging narratives.

• A creative mindset and the ability to generate innovative ideas that captivate and inspire.

• A commitment to excellence and a desire to continuously learn and grow in a rapidly evolving industry.

Benefits
What do we offer you?

• Competitive salary package

• Full time/40 hours a week

• Unlimited PTO

• Flexible work schedule

• Team off-sites

• Young & dynamic culture with team members across 22+ countries

title: Part-Time Card Services Specialist
description:
Every Card Issue Has a Person Behind It.
Not every member contacts us on a good day.
Sometimes they're dealing with fraud.
Sometimes they're questioning a transaction.
Sometimes they simply need answers.
As our Card Services Specialist , you'll help members navigate those moments while protecting their accounts, solving complex problems, and providing the kind of service that builds trust.
Some people process transactions. Others help protect members.
What You'll Be Solving
This role includes the operational responsibilities you'd expect within Card Services, but the impact goes well beyond processing transactions. You'll:

• Help protect members by investigating fraud activity and processing disputes and chargebacks.

• Analyze complex card transactions and determine appropriate resolutions.

• Support members with card-related questions, digital wallet solutions, card controls, and tokenization services.

• Partner with frontline teams and internal departments to resolve issues and provide guidance on card processing.

• Maintain accurate account records while navigating changing regulations, card-network requirements, and operational procedures.

• Help ensure members receive clear communication, timely updates, and exceptional service throughout the resolution process.

Why This Opportunity Is Different
Very few operational roles offer the opportunity to:
✅ Protect members from fraud
✅ Solve complex financial problems
✅ Build trust during difficult situations
✅ Continuously learn as payments technology evolves
✅ Make a direct impact on members' financial well-being
Most members never think about Card Services until something goes wrong. When they do, they're looking for someone who can provide answers, guidance, and peace of mind. That's where you come in.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...
You communicate clearly, make thoughtful decisions, and take ownership of resolving issues.
You enjoy figuring out what happened, why it happened, and what needs to happen next.
Most importantly, the idea of helping people through difficult situations is meaningful to you.
Make A Difference Every Day
Years from now, members won't remember the case number, the dispute documentation, or the transaction details. They'll remember how you helped them when they needed it most.
The work isn't always easy. The situations aren't always simple. But helping a member recover from fraud, resolve an issue, or find answers is work that matters.
Ready to put your curiosity, problem-solving skills, and member-first mindset to work? We'd love to talk

title: Product Engineering
description:
PRODUCT ENGINEERING AT POLAR

Product engineering at Polar is about shaping and building the finance layer for the next generation of AI products. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents - from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products.

We’re interested in engineers who enjoy working across our entire stack, solving complex technical challenges while shaping how developers interact with and experience Polar. We value engineers who think beyond implementation, challenge assumptions and bring the technical depth and product judgement to make sophisticated systems feel simple.

We operate as a small, remote-first team with a strong bias towards shipping. We value engineers who can work independently, collaborate when it matters and maintain a high bar for quality without sacrificing speed.

More about Polar and how we work https://polar.sh/company

WHAT YOU COULD WORK ON

Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include:

- Own product development end-to-end: Identifying opportunities, shipping and iterating on features across our stack - taking responsibility for both the technical implementation and the product outcome.

- Build exceptional developer experiences: Bringing a strong eye for design, usability and detail to everything you ship. Turning complex billing and monetization workflows into intuitive interfaces, powerful APIs and thoughtful abstractions that make our merchants’ lives easier.

- Ship with speed and quality: Delivering improvements continuously, balancing fast iterations with robust engineering, performance and attention to detail.

- Stay close to our users: Engaging with our merchants, to understand how they use Polar, uncover pain points and translate feedback into meaningful product improvements.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine strong technical foundations with exceptional product judgement and design sensibility. People who care deeply about developer experience, have opinions about what makes great software and know that building the right thing often means knowing what not to build.

Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include:

- Strong technical foundations: Experience building, shipping and evolving production software, with deep expertise in at least one part of the stack and the ability to work confidently across frontend and backend systems. You’ve built and maintained products long enough to understand how early technical and product decisions hold up as they evolve and scale.

- Product judgement & design sensibility: A deep appreciation for how products look, feel and work. An understanding that developer experience is the product, from the clarity of an API to the smallest details of an interface. Strong opinions, loosely held, and the judgement to challenge assumptions, simplify complexity and know what to leave out.

- Ownership & pragmatic execution: The ability to take problems end-to-end with high ownership and autonomy, navigate ambiguity, make decisions without perfect information and take responsibility for outcomes. A bias towards shipping and knowing when to iterate quickly and when to invest in stronger foundations.

- Engineering craft: A commitment to the quality of what gets built - from clean APIs and robust backend logic to thoughtful interactions, edge-case handling and performance. High standards for both technical quality and the experience delivered.

- Curiosity & collaboration: A willingness to wear multiple hats, collaborate openly and contribute to a small team. Curiosity to learn new technologies and use tools, including AI-assisted development, while maintaining intimacy with the code, sound engineering judgement and ownership of what gets shipped.

You will work closely with the Senior Manager of Network & Cloud Infrastructure and partner with IAM, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security teams. Together, you will build a network that verifies identity, checks device posture, and enforces least privilege from edge to cloud! You will bring this project to a definitive close.

• Lead the global site topology mapping effort by detailing all international sites. Define the tiered support model and produce the hardware refresh sequencing plan linked to the ZTNA rollout waves.

• Partner with the Automation / Network Reliability Engineer to build self-healing policy frameworks, Panorama API automation patterns, and CI/CD pipeline standards for network configuration changes.

• Represent Network Engineering in cross-functional architecture reviews alongside IAM, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, and Central Technology - you bring the network angle in conversations where enterprise architecture is decided.

• 10+ years of enterprise network engineering with demonstrated depth in large-scale architecture building - not just operations.

• Advanced knowledge of Palo Alto NGFW and Panorama - template hierarchy, device groups, security policy development, NAT, decryption policy, and multi-vsys environments.

title: Senior Director, Revenue Analytics
description:
LeadVenture is looking for a Senior Director, Revenue Analytics & Planning to join our team. This position will report directly to the CRO. This role owns forecast methodology, capacity and quota planning, compensation modeling, conversion and productivity metrics, and annual planning, and serves as a strategic advisor to the CRO on board-level reporting.
LeadVenture is the leading digital platform provider for powersports, RV, marine, trailer, agriculture, and automotive dealers across North America. Our portfolio of brands, including Dealer Spike, InteractRV, Net Driven, Firestorm, and Frazer, provides dealers with website platforms, digital marketing services, and subscription software products that drive traffic, generate leads, and grow revenue.
We are a private equity-backed company in active growth mode, expanding our software and subscription product footprint across an existing customer base of thousands of dealers. Operating multiple brands, multiple products, and multiple sales motions simultaneously is our defining operational challenge - and our biggest opportunity.
The Opportunity
As LeadVenture scales across multiple brands, products, and sales motions, the opportunity is to bring them together under one trusted framework for how we forecast, plan, and model the business - so leadership can make faster, better-informed decisions.
The Senior Director of Revenue Analytics & Planning owns that framework. You will set the methodology behind our forecast, capacity, quota, and compensation models, define the conversion and productivity metrics the business runs on, and lead annual planning from the revenue side. You will be a strategic partner to the CRO and the analytical conscience of the GTM organization: when a number goes in front of leadership or the Board, you are the reason it can be trusted.
This is a senior pillar leadership seat in Revenue Operations, reporting to the Chief Revenue Operations. You will lead the Revenue Analytics & Planning team, so your time goes to judgment, design, and insight, not data pulls.
What You'll OwnForecast Methodology

• Own the forecast methodology across brands, products, and sales motions - how we call the number, how we weight pipeline, and how we measure and improve accuracy

• Run forecast accuracy reviews; diagnose misses by brand, segment, and rep and drive the fixes

• Partner with FP&A to keep the GTM forecast and the financial plan reconciled to one number

Capacity & Quota Planning

• Build and own the capacity model: headcount, ramp, productivity, attrition, and coverage assumptions that translate a bookings target into a hiring and pipeline plan

• Own quota-setting methodology and territory/segment allocation; make sure quotas are achievable, defensible, and tied to the plan

Compensation Modeling

• Model sales compensation plans - cost of sales, payout curves, accelerators, and scenario analysis - and recommend plan design to leadership

• Monitor plan performance in-year: attainment distribution, payout vs. budget, and unintended behavior

Funnel, Conversion & Productivity Metrics

• Define and govern the core GTM metrics: stage conversion, velocity, win rate, opportunity creation, pipeline coverage, and rep productivity

• Establish benchmarks and targets by brand and motion; surface where the funnel is leaking and what it costs

• Own the Math of the Business - the model that connects activity, pipeline, and bookings to the revenue target

Annual & Operating Planning

• Lead the revenue side of annual planning: targets, capacity, quota, comp, and pipeline requirements

• Build scenario models leadership can use to make trade-off decisions quickly

Executive & Board Insight

• Act as a strategic advisor to the CRO and CEO - turn analysis into clear recommendations and the so-what, not just the chart

• Own the analytical foundation for monthly board reporting and forecast commentary, and present directly to executive leadership as needed
